scripts.predev:web: node -e "const cp=require('child_process'); const path=require('path'); const fs=require('fs'); const root=process.cwd(); const locks=[path.join(root,'apps','customer','.next','dev','lock'),path.join(root,'apps','vendor','.next','dev','lock'),path.join(root,'apps','pos','.next','dev','lock')]; for (const p of locks) { try { fs.rmSync(p,{force:true}); } catch {} } if (process.platform!=='win32') process.exit(0); const ports=[3000,3001,3004,8080]; const ps=[\"$ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'\",\"$ports=@(\"+ports.join(',')+\")\",\"foreach($port in $ports){\",\"  $conns=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\",\"  foreach($conn in $conns){ try { Stop-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {} }\",\"}\"].join('; '); cp.spawnSync('powershell',['-NoProfile','-Command',ps],{stdio:'ignore'});"
